verdict.rationale: jo documents an official native macOS app and says it runs on your Mac, which covers the desktop-app core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows OS-level shortcuts or the ability to see what is on your screen. Missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-content access or screen-awareness, Windows/Linux desktop coverage, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: jo speaks on macOS (native app), Telegram, WhatsApp, and email — same memory and context across all of them.
